name: Fail-closed Citation and Output Security Gate
mechanism: Validates source identity, version, authorization, claim support and output policy before returning an answer or permitting downstream agent actions.
use_when: Answers must be traceable to governed evidence
Unsupported or sensitive output can cause material harm
avoid_when: The application cannot bind generated claims to exact retrieved versions
A verifier model is used as the sole allow or deny authority
expected_effects: Reduced fabricated citation and unsupported-claim delivery
Fail-closed handling of sensitive generated output
failure_modes: Exact citation exists but does not entail the claim
Output policy misses transformed secrets or PII
required_evals: verifier outage and model-only fallback denial
